== Summary ==
Identified: [[Jacy Smith]] (center, from behind, green shirt), named in the poster's caption "Jacy being unimpressed by Lincoln".
[[Jacy Smith]] at the Lincoln Memorial in Washington, D.C., on 11 October 2021, the day after the [[2021 World Championship]] (Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).

* '''Event:''' [[2021 World Championship]] (trip after the event)
* '''Camera timestamp:''' 2021:10:11 14:57:59 (EXIF; camera clock not verified)
* '''Date posted:''' 2021-11-11
* '''Image:''' native forum attachment, rotated upright losslessly to 2256×4032 from the 4032×2268 camera file (EXIF orientation applied, metadata removed; replaced an earlier 2400 px copy on 22 November 2026).
